title: Matami hoo lab pe
body:
matami hoo lab pe mere ya hussain aa jayega
qabr mein ek pal lagega mujhko chain aa jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
mai to bas nauha padunga aur karunga kya bhala
ek qaidi karbala se karne bain aa jayega
matami hoo lab pe mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
roze mehshar hoonga jab mai apne rab ke roo ba roo
bakshwane fatema ka noor e ain aa jayega
matami hoo lab pe mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehn mein rach bas gayi hai roz e ashoora ki soch
saath sau chauke wahan ka shor o shain aa jayega
matami hoo lab pe mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
rooh to tanha na pahunchegi dar e mazloom par
jism bhi to saath bainul qiblatain aa jayega
matami hoo lab pe mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhalte dhalte dhal hi jayega wo din ashoor ka
zer e khanjar do jahan ki zeb o zain aa jayega
matami hoo lab pe mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
raaste mein lehad se karbobala jaate huwe
saamara kufa najaf aur kaazmain aa jayega
matami hoo lab pe mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab jahan mushkil padi abid madad ke waaste
wohi ibne faatahe badr o hunain aa jayega
matami hoo lab pe mere...
author: Abid Zaidi
